caption: Zuidertoren, Schiermonnikoog
composition: White tower with a copper dome in the dunes · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Zuidertoren is the white tower in the dunes at the edge of the village. It was built in 1853-1854 as the inner light and was converted to a water tower around 1950, so the glass lantern is gone and a copper dome with a small monk finial closes the top. The light is not burning. It is overcast, about 15.5°C, with wind near 6.8 km/h and cloud cover about 100%. The tower is not open at this hour. The red Noordertoren is another scene and is not in this frame.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the white Zuidertoren on Schiermonnikoog at night

qc_notes.note: Gate 1 hold (Cosmo QC 2026-09-26, verified by Cosmo's own read of both masters): the two format masters depict different towers - the 16:9 shows a tall white tapered tower with rows of porthole windows, a corbelled arcade band and an OPEN GLASS LANTERN room topped by a dark statue figure, while the 4:5 shows a much shorter squat white cylinder with two portholes and a solid copper dome. The card's own geometry anchor 3 requires 'a copper dome, not a glass lantern' (lantern removed in the ~1950 water-tower conversion), so the 16:9 contradicts the documented site. Builder to re-render the 16:9 to the copper-dome design and re-push; approval awaits corrected masters.

Gate 1 re-audit PASS (Cosmo QC 2026-09-26): re-rendered masters re-verified - both formats show the white round shaft closed by the copper dome with its finial figure, matching the card's copper-dome anchor; the earlier glass-lantern-vs-squat-tower discrepancy is resolved. On-image caption/scenario/disclosure/signature and Art. 50 PNG metadata verified on the new masters. Hold resolved.

approval_basis: Five-gate Cosmo QC 5/5, night scene. Gate 1: both formats show the white round shaft of the Zuidertoren rising from marram-grass dunes under dark clouds, closed by the copper dome with its small finial figure, small square window near the crown and dark arched door at the base in both - matching the card's 'copper dome, not a glass lantern' anchor; the earlier inter-format discrepancy is resolved in the 20:49 UTC re-render. Gate 2: label bar exact - 'Zuidertoren, Schiermonnikoog', 'Scenario: 26 September 2026 · 04:18 Europe/Amsterdam', AI disclosure, signature pair; Open-Meteo retrieval 2026-09-26T04:18:37+02:00, unique to the second repo-wide, scenario minute 04:18 inside model-valid hour 04:00-04:59; PNG Title/Description/Copyright/Software/Comment with EU AI Act Art. 50 note. Gate 3: text-prompt-only lineage per evidence card, no photographic inputs. Gate 4: no identifiable people, no logos, no credit required - documented only. Gate 5: card fields complete.
